description: Initialize Next.js 14 with App Router, Tailwind, dark theme (Task 5.1) and type-safe API client (Task 5.2) in apps/web.
steps: Update apps/web/package.json: add dependencies next@14, react@18, react-dom@18, @tanstack/react-query, zustand, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, next-auth, @open-music/shared workspace:*. DevDeps: @types/react, @types/react-dom
Create apps/web/tailwind.config.ts with content paths, dark mode 'class', extended theme with CSS custom property colors for dynamic palette (--color-primary, --color-surface, etc.)
Create apps/web/postcss.config.mjs with tailwindcss and autoprefixer plugins
Create apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx as root layout with dark theme class on html, TanStack QueryProvider, basic metadata
Create apps/web/src/app/page.tsx as home page placeholder
Create apps/web/src/app/globals.css with Tailwind directives (@tailwind base, components, utilities) and CSS custom properties for design tokens / dark theme defaults
Create apps/web/src/providers/query-provider.tsx wrapping QueryClientProvider with defaultOptions (staleTime, retry config)

Create apps/web/src/lib/api-client.ts as a type-safe API client wrapper: base fetch function with auth header injection, error handling that parses ProblemDetails, typed methods for auth endpoints (login, register, refresh, me, logout)
Update apps/web/tsconfig.json to include jsx: 'preserve', paths for @/ alias, include app directory and new file structure
Update apps/web/package.json scripts: build -> 'next build', dev -> 'next dev --port 3001', typecheck stays as tsc --noEmit
Remove apps/web/src/index.ts (replaced by Next.js app directory structure)
Run pnpm install, then pnpm run typecheck and pnpm run lint to verify
acceptance_criteria: apps/web uses Next.js 14 with App Router (src/app/ directory)
Tailwind CSS is configured with dark theme as default
TanStack Query provider wraps the app
Type-safe API client exists at src/lib/api-client.ts with typed methods
pnpm run typecheck passes (including the web package)
findings: Next.js build auto-modifies tsconfig.json to add allowJs:true and .next/types/**/*.ts to include. It also generates next-env.d.ts. Pre-commit hooks (lint-staged) ran successfully on all staged files. Build output mode is standalone.
